description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity of an Android application for a Jumping Jack exercise app. It manages sensors, UI components like ViewPager and Fragments, and handles activity lifecycle events, sensor data processing, and user interaction such as counting jumps and resetting the counter.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity for the Jumping Jack app, handling sensor events, user interface, and jump counting logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets the layout, views, sensor management, and timer.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Configures the ViewPager, indicators, and associated fragments.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listener when activity pauses.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles sensor data changes and detects jumps.

methods.name: detectJump
methods.description: Implements logic to detect upward or downward hand movements indicating a jump.

methods.name: onJumpDetected
methods.description: Handles the event when a jump is detected, updates counter and UI.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Updates UI, saves counter, and triggers vibration on milestone.

methods.name: resetCounter
methods.description: Resets the jump counter to zero.

methods.name: resetFlag
methods.description: Clears the keep-screen-on flag and finishes activity.

methods.name: setIndicator
methods.description: Updates page indicator icons based on current page.
